title.zh: 环境卫生（执照修改）条例 2019
title.en: Environmental Public Health (Modification of Licences) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Environmental Public Health (Modification of Licences) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 10 June 2019.

heading.en: Prescribed period to make written representations

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 99(12B)(b) of the Act, the period of time after the date of service of notice on a licensee within which the licensee may make written representations with respect to a proposed modification of any condition of the licensee’s licence, is 14 days.

3. In these Regulations, “licence” includes any approval, permit, permission, authority, authorisation or licence which may be granted or renewed under the Act, but does not include a cleaning business licence granted or renewed under Part IXA of the Act.
